title: 模拟行走机器人
summary: 机器人从原点朝北，按前进、左转和右转指令移动，不能进入障碍格，求过程中到原点最大欧氏距离平方。
insight: 逐单位执行前进指令才能在障碍前停下；把障碍坐标编码进集合，方向用四个向量和模四下标维护。
pitfalls: 遇障碍时当前前进指令剩余步数全部停止
答案在每个实际移动后更新

solutions.title: 逐步障碍模拟
solutions.idea: 用方向下标和坐标集合执行全部命令。
steps: 把 obstacle 编码为 x,y 字符串或整数对集合
direction=北；-1 令 direction=(direction+1)%4，-2 令 direction=(direction+3)%4
正命令逐步计算 next，若是障碍 break，否则更新坐标和最大 x²+y²

code.java: class Solution { public int robotSim(int[] commands,int[][] obstacles){Set<String> blocked=new HashSet<>();for(int[] obstacle:obstacles)blocked.add(obstacle[0]+","+obstacle[1]);int[][] directions={{0,1},{1,0},{0,-1},{-1,0}};int direction=0,x=0,y=0,answer=0;for(int command:commands){if(command==-1)direction=(direction+1)%4;else if(command==-2)direction=(direction+3)%4;else for(int step=0;step<command;step++){int nextX=x+directions[direction][0],nextY=y+directions[direction][1];if(blocked.contains(nextX+","+nextY))break;x=nextX;y=nextY;answer=Math.max(answer,x*x+y*y);}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun robotSim(commands:IntArray,obstacles:Array<IntArray>):Int{val blocked=obstacles.map{it[0] to it[1]}.toSet();val directions=arrayOf(intArrayOf(0,1),intArrayOf(1,0),intArrayOf(0,-1),intArrayOf(-1,0));var direction=0;var x=0;var y=0;var answer=0;for(command in commands){if(command==-1)direction=(direction+1)%4 else if(command==-2)direction=(direction+3)%4 else repeat(command){val nextX=x+directions[direction][0];val nextY=y+directions[direction][1];if(nextX to nextY in blocked)return@repeat;x=nextX;y=nextY;answer=maxOf(answer,x*x+y*y)}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int robotSim(vector<int>& commands,vector<vector<int>>& obstacles){set<pair<int,int>> blocked;for(auto& obstacle:obstacles)blocked.insert({obstacle[0],obstacle[1]});int directions[4][2]={{0,1},{1,0},{0,-1},{-1,0}},direction=0,x=0,y=0,answer=0;for(int command:commands){if(command==-1)direction=(direction+1)%4;else if(command==-2)direction=(direction+3)%4;else for(int step=0;step<command;++step){int nextX=x+directions[direction][0],nextY=y+directions[direction][1];if(blocked.count({nextX,nextY}))break;x=nextX;y=nextY;answer=max(answer,x*x+y*y);}}return answer;} };
